paragraphs.text: Mezlok was a proud young human planeswalker and wizard . He was the great-grandson of Minoch . Taishiar was his servant.

Mezlok, with his companion Taishiar , hoped to compete in a contest of mages on Mirrankkar . Due to a run-in with a rival on Obsidias , they arrived the day before the contest and had only that day to find a city or town that would accept him to duel for them.

Mezlok made a link with the forest he arrived in, and then let a child lead them to the village of Gordahn , where the chief offered him the position of duelist that had been claimed by their village warder Jehadt . Jehadt was offended by this and challenged Mezlok to a duel. He lost and teleported away, hoping to face Mezlok again someday.
Mezlok, chosen by Gordahn, was the final entry in the contest.
